BASE.rule: Own observed acquisition schedule, byte-equivalent signal rows

E1.rule: Nominal Through green+10%; extra green from same-cycle RED; G onset and nextG onset fixed; Y duration fixed
E1.increment_rule: floor(min(0.1*G,RED-0.1)/0.1)*0.1;0.1s grid and positive RED constraint only
E1.partial_cycles: Unchanged unless a complete observed/edge-extended G/Y/R/G cycle is available
E1.all_red: Not separately observed in modeled schedules; no independent all-red phase changed

E2.rule: Single downstream intersection shift applied equally to both modeled NB/SB phase series
E2.source: B2 REAL complete no-stop Through effective-cut trips
E2.interpretation: CORRIDOR PROGRESSION STRATEGY FOR B2 DOMINANT THROUGH DIRECTION; same shift in B1, no B1 design

E3.rule: Exactly E1 then E2; same predeclared shift, never recompute offset

recommendation_rule: Pareto first; among alternatives non-dominated in both contexts, minimum equally pooled B1/B2 score with negative score in both; else NO_ALTERNATIVE_DOMINATES_BASELINE
limitations: Headway too high in TRAIN and holdout; long-gap tail remains inaccurate
Too few stopping episodes and overly long complete stops in both acquisitions
B1 speed KS is affected by real exact-zero mass versus positive near-zero IDM speeds; operational threshold not changed
Temporal flow useful but bin discrepancies remain; equal total throughput is demand closure, not capacity validation
REAL queue context includes non-target arterial vehicles; secondary only
Restricted Through class2/3 population, omitted turning/local streams and free receiving cuts
Entry speeds use frozen B2 boundary pool, not newly estimated B1 speeds
Prior feasibility-summary exposure; no blind or fully-unseen claim
Comparative experiments only within frozen scope and stated assumptions; no full-network or absolute-capacity claim
temporal_departures_definition: 30s counts and cumulative departures, ALL/NB/SB, every paired seed; positive E−BASE cumulative difference means earlier progress
